$comment: The skin picker's own words, in both languages.
Everything the room says normally comes from the engine's own translation
key that the engine does not define fails the suite. The picker uses those keys
wherever they exist — `Change Skin` (换肤), `default`, `Illustrator` — but the
engine has no word for 'stills only' or for what a third-party image host learns
about you, because upstream ships its artwork in the client and has no such
So the handful it has to say for itself lives here, following the precedent set
by `src/room/audio/labels.json` and for the same reason: JSON rather than a `.ts`
module, because `src/i18n/__tests__/coverage.test.ts` fails the suite for a
Chinese string literal anywhere under `src/**/*.ts(x)`, and it is right to — a
hardcoded string is a string the language toggle cannot reach. This file is read
through the same `useLanguage()` subscription the toggle drives, so switching
language repaints it like everything else.
Every Han here is already in the committed font subset (`scripts/glyphset.mjs`
walks `src/**/*.json` precisely so it can be), so no font rebuild is owed.
To adopt: move each row into `src/i18n/ui.ts` under the same key, delete this
file, and swap `label(lang, k)` for `t(k)` in SkinPicker.tsx.

skins.note.zh_CN: 皮肤由第三方服务器加载，会向对方暴露你的 IP 地址。
skins.note.en_US: Skins are fetched from servers we do not run, which will see your IP address.

skins.hint.zh_CN: 只有你能看到，随时可以更改；其他座位不受影响。
skins.hint.en_US: Only you see this. Change it whenever you like — no other seat is affected.
